title: CommunicationLogRequest
description: Validation rules for logging a communication event (Note, Call, or Meeting). F0021-S0001/S0002/S0003. Conditional rules for direction/duration are enforced by FluentValidation on the backend and custom form logic on the frontend; this schema enforces structural types and length constraints only.

direction.description: Required for Call (Inbound|Outbound only) and Meeting (Inbound|Outbound|Internal). Must be null for Note.

durationMinutes.description: Required for Call and Meeting (1–600 minutes). Must be null for Note.

subject.description: Optional short title. All event types.

body.description: Required free-text content. All event types.

outcome.description: Optional result or next step. Applicable to Call and Meeting.

occurredAt.description: When the interaction occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Defaults to server UtcNow if omitted. Must not be in the future.

primaryEntityType.description: The type of CRM entity this communication is logged against.

primaryEntityId.description: The ID of the linked entity.
